source.credit: The U.S. Drought Monitor is jointly produced by the National Drought Mitigation Center at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln, the United States Department of Agriculture, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration and the National Aeronautics and Space Administration. Map courtesy of NDMC.
source.note: Weekly map valid on the Tuesday (w), released the Thursday (released). Categories D0–D4 per the official USDM classification; geometry simplified to ~0.02° with slivers removed, so boundaries are approximate. SEED: newest week only, simplified to 0.2° with parts under 0.08 deg² removed.
